questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign tells you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are driving the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has multiple curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that buggies may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you which direction traffic flows on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane under it exits the freeway and does not continue through. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending. All traffic in that lane must move to the left.

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law you must obey. You cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pedestrians cross the road here. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The divided highway is about to end. This yellow diamond warning sign alerts you to this upcoming hazard.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: The road turns sharply ahead to the right. Slow down as much as you would for a turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: Workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A playground is near this road. Watch for children who may be in or near the roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: The overpass ahead is low. Do not pass under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep downhill slope is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you about a construction zone ahead. A flagger will direct traffic, so watch for them and follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a construction zone is starting ahead. Be careful and slow down in construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Adjust your driving if you see this hand signal from a vehicle ahead of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols. They alert you to potential hazards or special situations ahead.
